name: Gradientora
summary: Library of 1100+ gradient backgrounds — smooth, textured, 3D and animated — up to 8K, with Figma/Framer plugins and a shader tool.
description: Downloadable gradient assets organised into collections and categories: smooth blends, textured, 3D, animated and free. Assets are JPEG at up to 8K (6720x3840); paid plans add high-resolution downloads, a commercial license, Figma & Framer plugins and a real-time shader tool.
contains: 1100+ gradient assets across smooth-blend, textured, 3D, animated and free categories
downloads are JPEG at up to 8K (6720x3840)
paid plans: $29/month, $109/year, $299 lifetime; 200+ new gradients added monthly
Figma and Framer plugins plus a browser shader tool
free gradients available without a plan
